title: LHDS PDP decision input (PROVISIONAL v0)
description: PROVISIONAL, owned by W1-5. MUST be reconciled with the token-claims contract from W1-4 (feat/lhds-w1-4-scope-design, apps/loom-health-cp/src/auth/**) before any interceptor depends on it. Single place the PDP input shape is defined; the Rego reads only these paths.

token.description: Claims of the already-verified LHDS access token. The PDP does not verify signatures; the interceptor does (ADR-010).

tenant.description: Tenant slug the token was minted for.

scopes.description: SMART v2 scopes, ctx/Type.cruds. Granular (?query) scopes are NOT honoured in v1 and grant nothing.

patient.description: Launch patient id; required for patient/* scopes.

tenant.description: Tenant slug the request targets, taken from the route by the interceptor, never from the body.

resource_type.description: FHIR resource type, or the literal dicom for service=dicom.

patient.description: Patient compartment id of the target, when known.
